title: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma 'willing to question everything,' comes from AI background
content: Xbox VP Jason Ronald describes new Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma as 'willing to question everything.' Sharma's stated ambition is to 'retain what makes Xbox great' while reassessing previous strategies. Sharma comes from an AI background with no prior games industry experience, a combination Ronald suggests could be an asset. The appointment coincides with killing the 'This is an Xbox' campaign and multiple senior departures.
